definitions.explanation: The checkpoint at train stations where tickets are checked or validated.
The act of checking or validating tickets.

examples.japanese: {改札|かいさつ}を{通|とお}って{ホーム|}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went through the ticket gate to the platform.

examples.japanese: {改札|かいさつ}{口|ぐち}で{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせしよう。
examples.english: Let's meet at the ticket gate.

examples.japanese: {自動|じどう}{改札|かいさつ}が{故障|こしょう}していた。
examples.english: The automatic ticket gate was out of order.

notes:
USAGE: {改札|かいさつ} is an essential term for using trains in Japan.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{改札|かいさつ}{口|ぐち} (ticket gate area/exit)
・{自動|じどう}{改札|かいさつ} (automatic ticket gate)
・{有人|ゆうじん}{改札|かいさつ} (staffed ticket gate)
・{改札|かいさつ}{機|き} (ticket gate machine)
・{改札|かいさつ}{内|ない}/{外|そと} (inside/outside the ticket gates)

IC CARDS: Modern {自動|じどう}{改札|かいさつ} accept IC cards (Suica, Pasmo, ICOCA, etc.) as well as traditional paper tickets.

MEETING SPOTS:
・{改札|かいさつ}{口|ぐち}で{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ (meeting at the ticket gate) is a common arrangement in Japan.
